name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a grounded, intense stare, the weight of the earth in her gaze.
components.effects: Fine motes of {{MAGIC}} dust and drifting leaf litter swirl gently around her feet, stirred by unseen earth magic. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Terrador, visible in the distance among the trees, an Elder Dragon of deep burnt-sienna and antique-bronze scales veined with vivid turquoise, trailing drifting dust and stone fragments, wings like slabs of weathered stone edged in antique bronze

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
